theme: EIA, SEA and Habitats Regulations assessment

sources.title: Environmental Impact Assessment
sources.facts: Guidance explains the Town and Country Planning Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations 2017 and the screening-to-decision process.
sources.guard: Environmental assessment guidance, screening routes, consultation advice and assessment reports do not by themselves prove that significant effects are absent, mitigation is effective, alternatives are acceptable or consent can lawfully be granted.
